title: One file for the whole stack

blocks.content: Compose describes every service, network, and volume your app needs in a single file, so starting the stack is one command instead of a page of notes.

services:
  api:
    build: .
    ports: ['3000:3000']
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app@db:5432/app
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy

  db:
    image: postgres:17
    volumes: ['pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data']
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U app']
      interval: 5s

volumes:
  pgdata:
